about.name: Subhamoy Chowdhury
bio: Hey, I'm Subhamoy Chowdhury, a passionate BCA student and aspiring Full Stack Developer with a strong interest in creating secure, scalable, and user-friendly web applications.
I enjoy working with both front-end and back-end technologies and continuously strive to improve my skills in C, Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, and MySQL.

As a student member of the Computer Society of India (CSI), I actively explore new technologies and industry trends while building a solid foundation in software development. Beyond coding, I enjoy photography and video editing, which help me bring creativity and a fresh perspective to my work.

experience.desc: Building end-to-end web products for clients worldwide. From REST API architecture to pixel-perfect frontends. Also handling brand identity, design systems, and digital presence.
Commercial photography, video production and post-processing. Color grading, retouching, and cinematic video editing for brands and individuals.
Deep dive into the MERN stack. Built 10+ personal projects, open source contributions, and developed a strong foundation in modern full-stack development patterns.

projects.title: Course-selling platform
projects.desc: A full-stack course selling platform — browse and purchase courses, Stripe payment integration, JWT auth, instructor dashboard, and real-time enrollment tracking with map-based user insights via Leaflet.

projects.title: Durgapuja website
projects.desc: A cultural festival website for a family Durga Puja celebration — event gallery, sponsor showcase, and admin-managed uploads via Cloudinary. Built with MERN stack and Vite for a fast, immersive experience.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.desc: My personal portfolio showcasing projects, blog posts, and contact info. Responsive, performance-optimized, and accessible.
